title: Capacity allocation request orchestration playbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Goal: define a single orchestration playbook for capacity allocation requests that ties throughput guarantees, autoscaling policy choices, and fleet control knobs to a clear approval matrix and planning artifacts. This ticket captures the operational flow for sales/CS/solutions to request reserved capacity, the PM/Infra approval runway, and the capacity planning outputs (estimator, target pool configuration, expected SLOs). The deliverable is a documented playbook + checklist, a suggested approval matrix, and example filled requests for three customer archetypes (startup PLG, mid-market, enterprise with compliance).
acceptance_criteria: A single playbook doc exists in Confluence with step-by-step flow for request intake, technical triage, approval, provisioning handoff, and post-provision validation
Approval matrix defined: who approves P0/P1/P2 requests and required artifacts (traffic profile, retention, data locality, contract terms)
Autoscaling policy recommendations mapped to workload archetypes (latency-sensitive, throughput-bursty, batch embedding) with default parameter sets
Throughput guarantee tiers defined (t0/t1/t2) including 95th/99th token latency SLO targets and billing modification clauses
Operational checklist for Fleet Controls (node placement, GPU types, isolation tags, preferred regions) and rollback criteria
Three example completed request forms attached (startup small, SaaS mid-market, regulated enterprise) demonstrating end-to-end plan
Stakeholder approval captured from Security, Infra, and Legal (comments resolved)
steps: Intake: customer success or sales opens capacity allocation request via internal form (link to form in links). Required fields: traffic profile, 95th/99th latency target, expected queries per second, token mix, retention needs, region, contract term.
Triage: Infra Engineer reviews technical feasibility (kernel compatibility, expected queue depth, KV cache implications). Determine if Dedicated or Private required.
Sizing & Plan: PM runs capacity estimator to produce suggested GPU pool size, autoscaling headroom, and cost estimate. Attach estimator output to request.
Approval: Use approval matrix. Low-impact requests auto-approve within 24h; medium escalates to PM; high requires Infra + Security + Legal sign-off.
Provision: Infra schedules the capacity in fleet control plane and applies autoscaling policy template. Tag pool with customer ID and SLA tier.
Validation: Run synthetic traffic tests to validate throughput guarantees and latency SLOs. Post results to ticket and notify requester.
Handoff: Enable console dashboards for customer and schedule 2-week operational review. Document rollback plan and cost monitoring alerts.
